cohort: 60 women with gestational diabetes mellitus were randomly assigned to receive either metformin or insulin therapy.
finding: Metformin therapy for gestational diabetes mellitus was associated with a significantly lower mean birthweight in neonates (3.2+/-0.20 Kg) compared to insulin therapy (3.67+/-0.19 Kg).
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was 43.3% in the metformin group and 36.7% in the insulin group, showing no significant difference.
birth_weight: Metformin group: 3.2+/-0.20 Kg; Insulin group: 3.67+/-0.19 Kg
gest_age: At enrolment: Metformin group: 28.13+/-2.30 weeks; Insulin group: 28.26+/-2.46 weeks
